title: Halley's Dream
description:
Halley's Dream is a beautiful third-person adventure game about a husky dog that woke up in a beautiful fantasy world. He will find that all other animals except one bear are turned into a stone by an evil dragon. Along the way, the player will experience a relaxed, dreamlike atmosphere, solve mysteries, and explore a beautiful world.Beautiful storyline.Various movement mechanics.Gameplay:You will travel through the world by following the beautiful storyline, solve interesting puzzles, learn new abilities by collecting items.Key Features:• Beautiful fantasy world with interesting puzzles to solve.

• Cozy and dreamlike experience.

• Compelling and memorable storyline.

• This is a short 1.5 - 2.5h to complete game.

• Play on your own pace - there is no need to finish the game fast, you are free to explore the world.
description_short: Halley's Dream is a beautiful third-person adventure game about a husky dog that woke up in a beautiful fantasy world where almost every other animal is turned into stone. The protagonist will need to find out who did it and how to revert the curse.
